title: Ananas Pineapple Melon - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Sweet Tasty Melon
description:
Grow Your Own Delicious Pineapple Melons!


KEY FEATURES
• Sweet, aromatic flavour with pineapple notes
• High-yielding variety with vigorous growth
• Perfect for home gardens and allotments
• Easy to grow for all skill levels
• Produces juicy, fragrant fruits


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucumis melo 'Ananas'
Colour: Yellow-orange skin with pale green flesh
Season: Summer
Growth Habit: Bushy / Trailing
Flavour: Sweet, juicy, and aromatic with distinct pineapple undertones
Time to Harvest: 75-90 days from planting


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Well-draining, fertile soil
Watering: Consistent watering, especially during fruiting
Spacing: 90-120 cm apart
Height: 30-60 cm (bushy habit)
Spread: 90-150 cm
Hardiness: UK H2 (typically grown as an annual)


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant in a sunny, sheltered spot once all danger of frost has passed.
• Ensure soil is rich in organic matter and drains well.
• Water regularly, keeping the soil consistently moist but not waterlogged, particularly when fruits are developing.
• Feed with a balanced fertiliser every 2-3 weeks once fruits start to form.
• Protect young plants from slugs and snails. Consider using cloches or fleece in cooler climates for an earlier start.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
